text.tspan: Share of pregnant women who have anemia
Anemia is a condition that develops when your blood lacks enough healthy red blood cells or hemoglobin.

tspan.tspan: Global Health Observatory / World Health Statistics - World Health Organization (WHO), via World Bank (2026)
Anemia is defined as hemoglobin levels lower than 110 grams per liter at sea level. Altitude can affect hemoglobin levels, requiring

text.tspan: adjustments to the threshold for diagnosing anemia.
